summary: Wrestling Up From Guard develops Dante Leon’s coming-up attacks from X, De La Riva, reverse De La Riva and butterfly.
description: A course on turning guard exchanges into wrestling attacks through distance, reactions and underhooks.
overview: Dante Leon’s Wrestling Up From Guard focuses on rising into attacks from the bottom. Distance management and forcing reactions introduce material from X guard and De La Riva; later sections address reverse De La Riva, whizzers, snapdowns and butterfly attacks. Its three volumes connect wrestling to existing guard positions.

guide.display_title: Dante Leon: Wrestling Up From Guard

fits: You want to attack by coming up from guard, with options from several starting positions.

includes: Distance management, reactions and wrestling up from X guard and De La Riva.
Reverse-De-La-Riva underhooks and whizzer responses; butterfly knee picks and arm drags.
limits: The starting point is guard. This is not a general course on takedowns from a standing tie-up.
